messages:
sam_support: Escalating to CS: AceroHealth (AC-7782) trial provision failing. Customer can't mint trial key; trial ends +96h. Support triaged to a 403 with `key_policy_mismatch`. They flagged legal review but haven't confirmed any policy changes yet.

infra-bot: provisioning-service error id=pf_9c3d; status=403; message=tenant_restricts_trial_keys

maya_csm: On it. Can someone paste the exact API response and whether this reproduces from our staging environment? We should plan a short call with the customer and a temporary unblock if possible.

sam_support: Repro'd on staging and prod. Response: `{\"error\":\"forbidden\",\"code\":403,\"detail\":\"tenant restricts trial key issuance\"}` Request used: `POST /v1/accounts/AC-7782/keys {\"policy\":\"trial\",\"scopes\": [\"embed:read\",\"embed:write\"]}`

oliver_csm: Renewal signal: medium-high. AC-7782 estimated ARR $72k. If they can't test key workflows they may pause purchase. Priority: p1 for CS outreach.

maya_csm: Proposed immediate plan: 1) 15m unblock call with customer (confirm use-case + repro) 2) issue narrow-scope temporary key (ops sign-off) 3) schedule full enablement session next week 4) craft comms to set expectations. Who can join the 15m window in the next 90 mins?

sam_support: I'm available. Ops notes: tenant flag `restrict_trial_keys=true` set at signup. We can either flip the flag (needs change review) or generate a support-scoped key with limited TTL/scopes. Ops prefer temporary key route. Example internal call:
```
POST /internal/ops/keys
{ \"account\":\"AC-7782\", \"scopes\":[\"embed:read\"], \"ttl\":86400, \"note\":\"cs-temp-unblock\" }
```

ada_success_manager: I can handle the enablement deep-dive. Please cc legal only if we must persist changes to tenant policy. For now temp key + transparent comms to customer is best.

intra-bot: ops-ticket created: https://redwood.internal/t/ops/6189 (assigned infra oncall).

maya_csm: Draft message to customer: "Hi <Name>, we found a policy blocking trial key creation. We're arranging a 15-min call to get you unblocked and can provide a temporary key so you can continue testing today. We'll follow up with details and next steps." Thoughts?

oliver_csm: Short and clear. Add one sentence about security: "The temporary key is limited and will be revoked after 24h; we'll coordinate any permanent changes with your team."

sam_support: Ops oncall approved temp key issuance (24h, narrow scope). Issued key id `tk-temp-77x`. I pushed the key into the account; please ask customer to retry.

maya_csm: Just had the customer on the short call. They retried and provisioning succeeded with the temp key. They want a full enablement next Tue and asked for a brief write-up of what happened for their security docs.

ada_success_manager: I'll draft the enablement agenda: 1) review intended workflows 2) walk provisioning & key rotation 3) production rollout checklist 4) security controls and policy options. I'll also prepare a short incident summary for their docs.

sam_support: Filing a follow-up engineering change request to support a tenant-level override with audit trail: PR #6198 (https://redwood.internal/pr/6198). Leaving ops ticket open until change is merged or tenant flag reconciled.

oliver_csm: Thanks everyone. I'll mark the account as "at-risk -> engaged" in the renewal tracker and loop AM for next steps. If anything regresses reopen. :thumbsup:

maya_csm: Marking thread resolved for now. Will update renewal signal after next week's enablement.

sam_support: Closing notes: temp key revoked after 24h, ops ticket waiting on PR. Customer satisfied for immediate testing.
